title: Preserve configured review authority across shared credentials

canonical_core.requested_outcome: Close #2677 by making the repo merge gate consume configured review-authority provenance independently of GitHub credential association, while retaining explicit non-authoritative remediation reporting and existing head-freshness semantics.
canonical_core.hard_constraints: Do not rebuild shipped assurance architecture, require separate GitHub accounts, trust self-asserted human labels, or weaken the review gate.
canonical_core.agent_may_decide: The smallest repo-local signed receipt shape, policy modes, failure statuses, tests, and maintainer guidance that preserve the existing separation-of-duty invariant.
canonical_core.escalate_when: A trustworthy configured authority cannot be represented without a new shipped review framework or a required private credential would be exposed to the acting implementation agent.
canonical_core.next_action: Implement a repo-local trusted review-authority receipt boundary and focused merge-gate regressions.
proof_expectations: An unsigned or self-asserted OWNER marker cannot authorize human-required review; a valid trusted receipt for the current head can.
Explicitly permitted non-human policy modes and existing stale-head/trusted-base carry-forward behavior remain intact.
completion_criteria: Configured human/independent authority is derived from a trusted receipt rather than author_association or marker prose.
Acting-agent self-review remains blocked and has a separate ready-for-re-review status path.
Valid configured authority, explicit non-human mode, stale-head rejection, and trusted-base carry-forward are proven.
canonical_core.closeout_decision: Continue to the session-log scope slice after this PR is proven and published.

intent.outcome: Preserve the distinction between permission to use a shared GitHub credential and authority to satisfy configured human or independent PR verification.
non_goals: Do not change shipped general assurance semantics.
Do not require separate GitHub accounts or trust marker-authored provenance.
Do not weaken current-head or patch-preserving trusted-base carry-forward checks.
